definition: Recursion is a technique where a function solves a problem by calling itself on a smaller version of the problem. A correct recursive function needs a base case so it eventually stops.

CSS Flexbox is a one-dimensional layout system for arranging items in a row or column. Use display: flex on a container, then control alignment with justify-content, align-items, gap, flex-direction, and flex-wrap.

TCP is connection-oriented and provides ordered, reliable delivery with retransmission. UDP is connectionless and has lower overhead, but delivery and ordering are not guaranteed. TCP suits web pages and file transfer; UDP suits real-time audio, video, and games when speed matters.
An HTTP status code describes the result of a request. 2xx means success, 3xx means redirection, 4xx means a client-side request problem, and 5xx means a server-side failure.
Photosynthesis is the process in which plants, algae, and some bacteria use light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen.
An event handler is a function that runs when an event such as a click, input, submit, or keypress occurs.
Responsive design adapts layout, type, spacing, and controls to different screen sizes using fluid sizing, flexible layout systems, and media queries.
Web accessibility means designing websites so people with different abilities can perceive, operate, understand, and navigate them, including through keyboard and assistive technology.
